title: Owner chooses survey pass and import tool, in-app reconstruction, or stop
goal: The owner chooses one of the three options after the trial
acceptance: The owner's choice is recorded with its date
privacy: The owner's reply is recorded without coordinates, addresses or private flight data
validation: The owner's dated reply in the record
escalation: A failure reopens the record with a failing case before any fix

effort.basis: One choice from three written options. The steps after it are estimated for option 1. Estimated 2026-11-26 from the record's scope at the harness 10.21.3 reconcile; no calibration samples exist yet (first hour estimates here). Estimate, not a measurement.
